query:
SELECT pi.id, pi.url, pi.alt, pc.slug as cat_slug, pc.name as cat_name 
FROM portfolio_images pi 
JOIN portfolio_categories pc ON pi.categoryId = pc.id 
WHERE pi.url IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY pc.id, pi.sort_order 
LIMIT 60;
